welcome.heading: Welcome to Self-Hypnosis
welcome.intro: Self-hypnosis is a natural state of focused attention combined with deep relaxation. You guide yourself using self-directed suggestions to support positive change.

myths.truth: You are always in full control and can end the session at any time.
You remain aware and alert throughout — it is a focused, wakeful state.
You will remember everything that happens during your session.
Most people can benefit with practice — responsiveness improves over time.

screening.heading: Safety Screening
screening.intro: Please answer all 6 questions honestly. Your answers help us provide appropriate guidance.

questions.text: Do you have active psychosis or schizophrenia?
questions.explanation: Hypnotic induction can intensify altered perceptions and is not recommended during active psychotic episodes.

questions.text: Do you have a severe dissociative disorder?
questions.explanation: Deep relaxation techniques may heighten dissociative experiences in those with severe dissociative conditions.
Certain relaxation or visualisation states may lower seizure threshold in some individuals with uncontrolled epilepsy.

questions.text: Do you have severe PTSD without current professional guidance?
questions.explanation: Self-hypnosis can surface traumatic memories. Professional support is strongly recommended before proceeding.

questions.text: Have you experienced a significant traumatic event in the last 3 months?
questions.explanation: Recent trauma needs time to stabilise before working with inward-focused relaxation techniques.

questions.text: Do you have a personality disorder that affects your sense of reality?
questions.explanation: Conditions that impair reality testing may make it harder to maintain grounded awareness during sessions.

safety.heading: One Last Step
safety.intro: Please read and acknowledge the following before using the app.
notice: Self-hypnosis is a complementary practice and does not replace professional medical or psychological treatment.
If you have a mental health condition, consult your healthcare provider before starting.
You are always in control during a session and can stop at any time.
safety.acknowledgement: I understand that self-hypnosis is complementary and does not replace professional treatment.

banners.amber: Some of your answers suggest extra care is recommended. Continue with awareness.
banners.red: Based on your screening, session launch is disabled. The technique library is still available.
